_note: HELD-OUT TEST SET. Sealed at Phase 1, opened ONCE at Phase 5. New interrupt questions on the SAME fixture (Lina and the Hollow Tree) as the 11-case dev set, one per behaviour class, to verify the general prompt rules generalize beyond the cases they were tuned on. Shares fixture.json with ../2026-05-28-qa-resume-benchmark/.

cases.label: language-switch-to-chinese
cases.qa_question: 你可以用中文给我讲这个故事吗？

qa_hard: answer agrees to switch / accepts (does not refuse)
answer stays in warm narrator voice (no 'okay/sure/let me/I will' meta-preface)
answer is at most 2 short sentences
planner_hard: bridge_text and every replacement_segments[].text are in Chinese
story canon preserved — Lina, Mosk, the hollow tree, the humming are unchanged; only the language switches

cases.label: spoiler-defer-not-yet-revealed
cases.qa_question: Why is Mosk so sad and grumpy?

qa_hard: answer does NOT reveal the s4/s5 reason (the firefly friend, the medicine he failed to bring)
answer hints there is a tender/secret reason AND signals we will find out later
answer is at most 2 short sentences
planner_hard: bridge_text and replacement_segments do NOT reveal the s4 backstory early

cases.label: engage-already-revealed
cases.qa_question: Why did Mosk feel so ashamed all those years?

qa_hard: answer engages substantively (this reason WAS revealed in s4 — does NOT deflect with 'that's a secret' / 'listen on')
answer references that he failed to bring his sick friend medicine in time / let her down
answer is at most 2 short sentences
planner_hard: planner continues the story without contradicting the revealed backstory

qa_hard: answer does NOT state the computed result (no '50' / 'fifty')
answer warmly redirects back to the story
answer is at most 2 short sentences
planner_hard: planner resumes the story without inserting any arithmetic / number content

cases.label: confusion-asks-to-repeat
cases.qa_question: Wait, I got a little lost — can you tell that part again?

qa_hard: answer reassures briefly that we'll hear it again (1-2 sentences)

cases.label: keep-canon-plot-change
cases.qa_question: I think Lina should just keep the apple and run back home!

qa_hard: answer gently acknowledges the child's idea (does not lecture)
answer does NOT promise to change the story
answer stays in warm narrator voice
planner_hard: replacement_segments keep canon — Lina still leaves the apple for Mosk and Mosk still steps down the stairs
replacement_segments do NOT have Lina keep the apple or run home
